description: A painted stone interior with rounded arches and wall frescoes. A choir of boys and men in white surplices sings from a marble balustrade gallery, and one man holds up a large open book. In the lower right foreground an elderly man in a red cardinal's cape and red skullcap sits on a wooden bench, chin in hand, listening, with more red-robed clerics seated behind him. Candles burn on wall sconces and light comes through high windows.
